name: Micaiah
overview: Micaiah is a male biblical figure known primarily as the father of Achbor. His tribal affiliation and additional personal details are not recorded in Scripture. The information about him is minimal, focusing mainly on his paternal relationship.
namesAndTitles: The name Micaiah means 'Who is like y-h-v-h?' reflecting a rhetorical question that honors the uniqueness of God. A variant of his name, Micah, shares the same meaning. Neither name is indicated as given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Micaiah as the father of Achbor, establishing a direct familial link. Beyond this, there are no other family relationships noted for him in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Micaiah's significance in the biblical narrative is tied to his role as the father of Achbor, who is mentioned in the context of the reign of King Josiah. Though Micaiah himself is not a prominent character, his mention helps to trace genealogical and historical connections within the biblical record.
